subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `AgentToolResult.control`, `canYield`, and `yieldToolResult(...)` as a stable public Plugin SDK mechanism for plugin-owned asynchronous interaction handoffs?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive and guarded, but the decision establishes a permanent plugin-facing result-control and catalog-visibility contract that cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in SDK contract
options.body: Approve the documented `canYield: true` plus sequential-execution contract and land after the exact-head required checks complete.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Keep the linked feature discussion open and narrow or redesign the public control contract before accepting a compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Adopt the opt-in SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented `canYield: true` plus sequential-execution contract and land after the exact-head required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing `sessions_yield` lifecycle is the runtime behavior this public contract exposes, and the PR discussion identifies jriff as its original contributor.
